# netactuate_server (Data Source)

Reads a Server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_server" "example" {
  id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Value sent to the NetActuate API for this field.

### Read-Only

- `bgp_peers` (List of Object) Value returned by the NetActuate API for this field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bgp_peers))
- `hostname` (String) Hostname assigned to the server.
- `image` (String) Value returned by the NetActuate API for this field.
- `image_id` (Number) Value returned by the NetActuate API for this field.
- `ip_v4` (String) Value returned by the NetActuate API for this field.
- `ip_v6` (String) Value returned by the NetActuate API for this field.
- `location_id` (Number) Value returned by the NetActuate API for this field.
- `package` (String) Value returned by the NetActuate API for this field.
- `plan_id` (Number) Value returned by the NetActuate API for this field.
- `public_ipv4` (String) Value returned by the NetActuate API for this field.
- `public_ipv6` (String) Value returned by the NetActuate API for this field.
- `state` (String) Value returned by the NetActuate API for this field.
- `status` (String) Value returned by the NetActuate API for this field.
